title: Tech Note: Implementing the 2003 Quick Report Editor

historical_commentary.text: The specific structural adaptations this note recommends for 4D 2003 are tied to that particular version's Quick Report engine transition and are of largely historical interest today, since 4D's reporting toolset has continued to evolve well beyond the 2003 baseline in subsequent releases.
related_updates: 4D's Quick Report engine and reporting toolset have continued to evolve substantially in versions since 2003
